verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              द्रौपदेया महाराज सर्वे पञ्च महारथाः। वैराटिरुत्तरश्चैव रथोदारो मतो मम ॥१॥
verses.english: Bhishma said O great king, all the five sons of Draupadi are Maharathas. The son of Virata, Uttara is also a mighty Ratha; such is my opinion.

verses.sanskrit: अभिमन्युर्महाबाहू रथयूथपयूथपः। समः पार्थेन समरे वासुदेवेन चारिहा ॥२॥
verses.english: Abhimanyu, of long arms, is a leader of commanders of groups of chariots and that slayer of enemies is equal in battle to the son of Pritha or Vasudeva,

verses.sanskrit: लब्धास्त्रश्चित्रयोधी च मनस्वी च दृढव्रतः। संस्मरन् वै परिक्लेशं स्वपितुर्विक्रमिष्यति ॥३॥
verses.english: Quick in the use of arms, capable of using diverse weapons, spirited and of firm vows, he will show forth his prowess today remembering the sufferings of his father.

verses.sanskrit: सात्यकिर्माधवः शूरो रथयूथपयूथपः। एष वृष्णिप्रवीराणाममर्षी जितसाध्वसः ॥४॥
verses.english: The hero, Satyaki of the race of Madhu, is a leader of commanders of groups of chariots. He is wrathful among the heroes of the Vrishni race and has conquered fear.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमौजास्तथा राजन् रथोदारो मतो मम। युधामन्युश्च विक्रान्तो रथोदारो मतो मम ॥५॥
verses.english: In the same way, O king, Uttamaujas is a mighty Ratha is my opinion; and the powerful Yudhishthira too is a mighty Ratha.

verses.sanskrit: एतेषां बहुसाहस्रा रथा नागा हयास्तथा। योत्स्यन्ते ते तनूंस्त्यक्त्वा कुन्तीपुत्रप्रियेप्सया ॥६॥
verses.english: Many thousand chariots, elephants and horses of these will fight, casting away all hopes of life, with the desire of securing the interests of the sons of Kunti,

verses.sanskrit: पाण्डवैः सह राजेन्द्र तव सेनासु भारत। अग्निमारुतवद्राजन्नाह्वयन्तः परस्परम् ॥७॥
verses.english: United with the sons of Pandu, O chief among kings, O Bharata, they will sweep through your army like fire and wind challenging them.

verses.sanskrit: अजेयौ समरे वृद्धौ विराटद्रुपदौ तथा। महारथौ महावीर्यौ मतौ मे पुरुषर्षभौ ॥८॥
verses.english: The two, Virata and Drupada, invincible and experienced in battle. They are are great car-warriors and these two foremost among men are endued with great energy.

verses.sanskrit: वयोवृद्धावपि हि तौ क्षत्रधर्मपरायणौ। यतिष्येते परं शक्त्या स्थितौ वीरगते पथि ॥९॥
verses.english: Though old in age they observe the duties of Kshatriya order and they will try, with all their might, to stay in the path walked over by heroes.

verses.sanskrit: सम्बन्धकेन राजेन्द्र तौ तु वीर्यबलान्वयात्। आर्यवृत्तौ महेष्वासौ स्नेहवीर्यसितावुभौ ॥१०॥
verses.english: Owing to their relationship with the Pandavas, O chief among king, those two great bowmen will get an increase of their energy.

verses.sanskrit: कारणं प्राप्य तु नराः सर्व एव महाभुजाः। शूरा वा कातरा वाऽपि भवन्ति कुरुपुङ्गव ॥११॥
verses.english: All men of long arms become heroes or cowards, O foremost among the Kurus, according to the cause for which they fight.

verses.sanskrit: एकायनगतावेतौ पार्थिवौ दृढधन्विनौ। प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा परं शक्त्या घट्टितारौ परंतप ॥१२॥
verses.english: These two rulers, of the earth, of firm grasp on the bow, with a singleness of purpose, will try with all their might, casting off all desire for life, in slaying your troops, O chastiser of foes.

verses.sanskrit: पृथगक्षौहिणीभ्यां तावुभौ संयति दारुणौ। संबन्धिभावं रक्षन्तौ महत् कर्म करिष्यतः ॥१३॥
verses.english: Each, at the head of their separate Akshauhini, will make fierce attempt and observing the duties of the relationship they will do great deeds.
verses.bhavadeepa: एकायनगतौ मरणैकशरणौ घट्टितारौ घट्टनं संघट्टं करिष्यतः ॥१२॥

verses.sanskrit: लोकवीरौ महेष्वासौ त्यक्तात्मानौ च भारत। प्रत्ययं परिरक्षन्तौ महत् कर्म करिष्यतः ॥१४॥
verses.english: The two heroes among men, the mighty bowmen, disregarding their lives, O Bharata, will perform great deeds making good the trust.
